import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();w=(p/'write_lane.py').resolve()
def save(n,o):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(w),n],input=json.dumps(o,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==0
assert h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())=='8dadeb24c5f59e3ff04be4968e81baacfe34232b99b4759d5f18a4c994f6f78c'
assert h((p/'source_get_guard.py').read_bytes())=='20e1cc05bd236a184923e83ecf948ade4bba94fca49eaad20c52d7ee2e4860f8'
d=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text());g=json.loads((p/'keyedresults.json').read_text());assert set(d)==set(g) and len(d)==20
chunks={};checks=[]
for k,v in d.items():
 q=pathlib.Path(v['chunk_path'])
 if str(q) not in chunks:chunks[str(q)]=q.read_bytes()
 b=chunks[str(q)];assert h(b)==v['chunk_sha256'];line=b.splitlines(keepends=True)[v['line_1based']-1]
 assert line==(p/f'raw/{k}.jsonl').read_bytes() and h(line)==v['raw_sha256']
 o=json.loads(line);assert o==v['original'] and o['statement']==g[k]['literal_statement'];assert h(o['statement'].encode())==v['decoded_statement_sha256'];assert g[k]['credit']==0
 checks.append({'id':k,'original_newline_bytes':line[-2:].hex(),'raw_sha256':h(line),'statement_sha256':h(o['statement'].encode())})
resources=json.loads((p/'resource-inventory.json').read_text());assert resources['GET_hops']==9 and max(resources['per_ID_hops'].values())==5
budget=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_charged']==3 and budget['queries_charged']==9
for q in p.glob('*.receipt.json'):assert json.loads(q.read_text())['exit']==0
boot=json.loads((p/'bootstrap-receipt.json').read_text());resources['bootstrap_receipt']={'path':'bootstrap-receipt.json','sha256':h((p/'bootstrap-receipt.json').read_bytes()),'record':boot};save('resource-inventory.json',resources)
status={'reservation_sha256':h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()),'exact20_verified':checks,'source_get_guard_sha256':h((p/'source_get_guard.py').read_bytes()),'denials_final_sha256':h((p/'inherited-denials.json').read_bytes()),'denials_limit':'Final fingerprint recorded. No independent pre-work denial-file hash was captured in this lane; no denial file writes performed. Do not overstate immutable-baseline attestation.','status':'ORDINARY_SOURCE_FINDINGS_COMPLETE_NO_ACCEPTANCE','findings':{'352572':'SOURCE_PUBLIC_EXCLUSION','352882':'ORDINARY_PASS_CONCRETE_PUBLIC_PROOF_CLAIM_HOLD','352973':'ORDINARY_PASS_COMPLETE_PRIOR_TRANSFER_RECOMMENDED_EXCLUSION','352972':'ORDINARY_EXACT_REFUTATION_PASS_PRIOR_SIGNIFICANCE_REVIEW_HOLD'},'parked_other_ids':16,'formal':'NONE','children':0,'credit':0,'accepted':52,'target':60,'procedural_failure_observed':False,'verification_scope':'Recorded runner/guard/write calls and preserved text. No universal process/network/systemwide enforcement attestation. No kernel or external proof validation.','terminal_manifest_exclusions':{'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'Self hash would be circular','terminal_manifest.receipt.json':'Runner writes true receipt after manifest child exits','terminal_manifest.output.txt':'Runner writes captured output after manifest child exits'}}
save('closeout-verification.json',status)
print('Verified all20 original bytes/objects/statements/chunks; helper and reservation;9 GETs;3 calls/9 queries; all completed runner exits0')
